3 · Create or enrich

No profile yet?

Qualified Franklin, Williamson County or nearby organizations serving Franklin may request an accurately labeled profile and preview the Community Member version.

Show me my member profile

Location must stay exact.

Franklin city-limit profiles are core. Nearby organizations may participate as Franklin-area organizations when relevant, but the profile must show the actual city or service area.

Profile is not required for an introduction.

A qualified organization can receive an honest Community Membership introduction before a profile exists. The create/review path is included in the conversation.

Contact details can change

Use the profile as a starting point, then confirm the current route.

Phone numbers, email addresses, websites, staff roles and booking/contact pages can change. Factual corrections remain free. If a public contact route looks outdated, use the organization’s current official/public source or request a factual correction before relying on it.
